simulator.note: Boots as the M3602 family with device.chipId 0x3603 (C3603): the bootloader at 0x000000 (whose chunk header has next = 0, followed at length + 0x80 = 0x020000 by maincode; chips/base.py:chunk_chain) reads the 8 MB flash via SPI quad I/O read 0xEB, unpacks the 9.3 MB maincode into RAM and starts it.  With _find_long_blocks breaking an unrolled crypto routine in maincode so Unicorn 2.1.4's TCG buffer does not overflow, the application starts the SEE co-processor ("M3606 SEE"), initialises the S3501 demodulator at I2C 0x33, and renders its 32-bpp ARGB8888 OSD (8 GE commands, 10 unique colours; without the board's encrypted anti-clone security IC at SCB I2C 0x10 it displays "SW is not designed for this HW, please change back to official SW! -----0a010a00 00000000").  Its 54-key remote table (0x44xx) uses the "necfirst" coding.

desc: Amiko ALI3606 (System ID 0A010A00) firmware 1.6.89 with the Edision HD GUI (2015-10-20) on an 8 MB SPI flash.

Built on the ALi M3606 / C3603 dual-core SDK (Libcore 7.24.0@SDK4.0ba.7.24_SAB_20130620) shared across Amiko and Edision receivers; silences UART TX via a dummy printf stub and checks an external anti-clone crypto chip at I2C 0x10 at startup.
